blocks.html: As San Pedro’s first licensed Cannabis dispensary, We Roll Up intends to provide a safe, secure and welcoming environment to bring legal weed to the community.
blocks.text: As San Pedro’s first licensed Cannabis dispensary, We Roll Up intends to provide a safe, secure and welcoming environment to bring legal weed to the community.

blocks.html: We function as part of the local society and we are proudly serving San Pedro and the surrounding areas with a hand-picked selection of the finest cannabis products at affordable prices. Recreational users, medical patients, novices or connoisseurs, all are warmly welcome!
